scope: 同一声明Cartan材料与引力子类中，alpha^2/mchi^2=1/(24kappa Lambda)不随z改变；冷支唯一条件驻点与局部能量修正不随重质量路径消失。保完整配对来源后，有限初码到全Fock及任意R的固定T线性响应、自能有1/K上界。未认证完整耦合来源误差、实际钟尺或GR恢复。
inputs_retained: Specified Cartan action, effective four-dimensional positive-norm branch, fixed b/v and minimal f=1 material.
Cold conserved-particle, diagonal, adiabatic fixed-density branch only for stationary formulas.
Free full material source drives a fixed-background linear response; finite initial code, arbitrary reference, zero induced initial component and bounded spatial readout.
certification_limits: Static or adiabatic preparation is not the t->infinity limit of an undamped response.
Exact finite columns are a single quadratic source mapping into the full Fock output, not a truncation of coupled dynamics.
Positive induced quadratic scalar energy excludes independent scalar state, vacuum and interaction energy; no complete stress tensor certificate.
No full coupled-source remainder, actual clock, nonlinear Einstein error, dark-matter or dark-energy identification.
Keeping an additional complete source is allowed; elimination of all scalar modes or selection of all parameters is not a goal prerequisite.
review_independence: Internal non-blind review; reviewer did not write 1191 author proof and independently rebuilt q/p source and augmented-ODE response without importing author code; no external peer-review claim.
